source: JPL DE421 SPK with NAIF lunar PA PCK/FK and generic PCK
baseline_model: DE421 geometric site directions (SPICE NONE correction)
scenario_model: Newtonian point-mass KDK sensitivity integration initialized from DE421 at start_utc
scenario_caveats: Does not reproduce DE421 PPN terms, asteroid perturbations, solar J2, or the evolving lunar orbit/orientation under modified GMs.
Use as a sensitivity scenario; do not label scenario output as DE421.

geometry_units.offsets: km relative to Earth-Moon barycenter in J2000
